title: Write src/greeting.txt and src/farewell.txt
body:
## Goal
Create two independent files, and nothing else:

- `src/greeting.txt` containing the single line `hello from perpetua`.
- `src/farewell.txt` containing the single line `goodbye from perpetua`.

Do not create or change any other file.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its content is exactly `hello from perpetua` followed by a newline
- [ ] `src/farewell.txt` exists and its content is exactly `goodbye from perpetua` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or modified

## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/greeting.txt').read() != 'hello from perpetua\n' or open('src/farewell.txt').read() != 'goodbye from perpetua\n')"`

## Context
- goal: `.session/loop-state.json` `goal.text` is the full specification of this task
- prior goal-met confirmation: owner request #162 (closed as completed) in `.session/loop-state.json` `owner_requests.recently_closed`; the files are not present in the checkout at shaping time (`Glob src/*.txt` found nothing), so they must be created

## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt` (new)
- `src/farewell.txt` (new)
